verdict.rationale: Flagsmith's Scheduled Flags queue a single flag change to apply automatically at one specified future time. That is a one-off scheduled action, not a recurring job or workflow schedule. Release Pipelines automate stage progression via triggers, but the evidence never describes cron-like or repeating schedules, so the scheduling feature is only adjacent and earns no credit for recurring jobs.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can schedule recurring jobs or workflows

citations.quote: Scheduled flags allow you to queue and automatically apply changes to feature flags at a specified future time
